name: lab
about: The turn reminder uses the checklist reminder runner: the same process, session and transcript boundaries, with one hold at most per Stop round. A self declaration needs a wake; files are JSON written under the test root (state/ is XDG_STATE_HOME, panel/ is AACP_STATE_DIR), missing removes a fixture file, and reason overrides the missing-call reminder. Missing observer and alarm directories mean no records.
reason: Before ending the turn, say whose move it is: call turn_end (mcp__aacpanel__turn_end) — owner with what you need from the person, self if something set will wake you, done if nothing waits. Then end the turn without a word about this.
